description.value:
Tags wild

Frame + both Arms. Skin-and-strut wings grown off a rebuilt shoulder girdle and both forearms. Fly Speed 30 feet while no more than lightly encumbered. Flying occupies both arms (no hands) unless the wings are folded; folded, you can always Glide.

Rider: They want the sky before a storm. In the hours before bad weather you are restless and take a –1 status penalty to Will saves to resist an urge to get airborne.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Fly Speed is explicitly conditioned on 'no more than lightly encumbered,' but no roll option or predicate for the actor's current encumbrance/load state exists anywhere in pf2e-source (checked base-speed.ts and the wider engine) -- granting it unconditionally would overstate a gated claim (over-applying is worse than under-applying), so the whole grant is flagged rather than shipped ungated. 'Flying occupies both arms unless folded' and the storm-restlessness Will penalty also have no hook: nothing ties a granted movement type to hand/arm availability, and 'restless before a storm' has no weather-trigger mechanism anywhere in pf2e.
